    StartersFrozone's frozen grapesGrapes rolled in lime juice and sugar, frozen solidHow to make it500g grapes1 lime50g caster sugarPick the grapes off the stem, wash and pat dry.Roll in the lime juice, then in the sugar.Spread on a lined tray and freeze until solid. Serve from the freezer in a chilled bowl.Nomanisan Island coconut prawnsCoconut panko prawns with a mango, chilli and lime dipHow to make it500g green prawns, peeled80g plain flour2 eggs, beaten60g panko breadcrumbs60g shredded coconut1 L vegetable oil1 mango1 red chilli1 limeButterfly the prawns. Mix the panko and coconut.Dip in flour, egg, then the coconut crumb.Blitz the mango with a little chilli and lime for the dip.Fry in the oil at 180°C in batches until golden.Jack-Jack's flaming cheese corn puffsWatch him catch fireHow to make itAs written, serves 4Puffed corn tossed in butter, cheddar powder, smoked paprika and a pinch of mild chilli, baked until toasty and orange like a baby on fire.Heat the oven to 160°C.Melt 50g butter and toss with 150g puffed corn snacks.Mix 3 tbsp cheddar cheese powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp garlic powder and a small pinch of mild chilli powder, and shake it over the corn until coated.Spread on a tray and bake 5 minutes until toasty.Cool 5 minutes before serving.MainsFamily dinner meatloafBeef and pork meatloaf with tomato glaze, mashed potato and peasHow to make it80g breadcrumbs100ml full cream milk500g beef mince250g pork mince1 onion, grated1 egg1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce80ml tomato sauce1kg potatoes60g butter300g frozen peasSoak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix lightly with both minces, onion, egg and Worcestershire.Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180°C.Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter. Cook the peas.Rest the loaf, slice and serve with mash and peas.Mirage's Nomanisan Island steak dinnerThe fancy villain dinner Bob gets with MirageHow to make itAs written, serves 4Eye fillet seared and rested with a glossy balsamic beef jus, creamy garlic potato gratin and buttered green beans with toasted almonds.Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream warmed with 2 crushed garlic cloves, salt and thyme, and bake at 160°C for 75 minutes.Season 4 eye fillet steaks (200g each), sear 3 minutes a side and rest 5 minutes.Add 400ml beef stock and 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar to the pan and reduce to a glaze, then whisk in 20g butter.Blanch 300g green beans and toss with butter and 30g toasted flaked almonds.SweetsEdna Mode's choc cakeRich almond meal chocolate cake with a plain chocolate glazeHow to make it300g dark chocolate150g butter4 eggs150g caster sugar100g almond meal100ml thickened creamHeat the oven to 160°C and line a tin. Melt most of the chocolate with the butter.Whisk the eggs and sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and almond meal.Bake, then cool completely in the tin.Melt the remaining chocolate with the cream and pour over. No decoration, no capes.DrinksFrozone's frozen mint lemonade slushBlended lemon and mint slush with a splash of lemonade, no alcoholHow to make it5 lemons120ml sugar syrup10 mint leaves4 mint sprigs, to garnish200ml cold water4 cups ice300ml lemonadeJuice four lemons. Slice the last into wheels.Blend the juice, sugar syrup, mint leaves, water and ice until slushy.Pour into glasses, top with a splash of lemonade and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint.
